question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Something that is no longer in use
solution:
The correct answer is **'Obsolete**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• Contemporary - living or occurring at the same time. (समकालीन )
 
• Obsolete - no longer produced or used; out of date. (अप्रचलित )
 
• Faded - gradually grow faint and disappear. (फीका)
 
• Aged - having lived or existed for a long time; very old. (बूढ़ा)
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that obsolete is the correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
